local_review.finding_body: Review Signal #4 was violated in tests/src/org.springframework.boot/spring-boot-testcontainers/4.1.1/build.gradle: spring-boot-test was pinned to 4.1.1, so this test suite would keep using that companion module when exercised against another supported spring-boot-testcontainers version.
local_review.finding_title: Version-pinned companion Spring Boot test dependency
local_review.fix_note: Changed the spring-boot-test dependency to use $libraryVersion, matching the target dependency and preserving the test suite across supported library versions. The resolved dependency remains 4.1.1 for the reviewed coordinate.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-library diff, test source and build configuration, metadata file shape, index and reported statistics. The tests are library-specific, run without native-image skips, use a separate test package, and the reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is a valid no-calls case. No legacy metadata files or unrelated library changes are present. After the correction below, the tree is approved. Targeted checkMetadataFiles, checkstyle, and javaTest all pass.
